doc.title: Chubby Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998

title: Writing books and fear of publishers
summary: Chubby discusses his books and his reluctance to send them to publishers.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: See I am afraid to send things to publishers because the publishers, like the readers, probably just graduated Cornell. And here I am at my age and stage and I’m writing with my flair of humor and they’d read this and say ohhh, yilch.
And I’d get a Dear John letter from him saying very nicely done there, uh, yeah, Chubby, right. But you know I won’t ruin my life for that. You know what that would do to me?
I know you couldn’t stand that.
I mean a Gold Award and they tell me I can’t write?
I can tell you have such a fragile ego.
Yeah, well yes, in a way. But I am basically a swell guy.
